name: anypdf
description: Secure agent-native PDF form filling, one-shot intake, and Tell-Jacky feedback. Load the anypdf router and confirm current support with `anypdf forms catalog`, including IMM0008; never promise support from a frozen form list. New-template intake accepts only the issuing authority's official blank PDF; `new_source` does not mean published or fill-ready. Do not guess unconfirmed facts or submit an application to an issuer on the user's behalf. IRCC PDFs still requiring Acrobat Validate are not ready for upload.
